purpose: Give the Pixel Android System Intelligence build the Qualcomm-DSP music-detector model its Now Playing engine loads through the Sound Trigger HAL, so ambient music recognition can be enabled on this Snapdragon unit.

files.name: music_detector.sound_model
files.role: generic sound model bytes; loaded by SoundTriggerManager.loadSoundModel as GenericSoundModel UUID 9f6ad62a-1f0b-11e7-87c5-40a8f03d3f15 onto sound-trigger module 0

files.name: music_detector.descriptor
files.role: protobuf map of classifier tunables (classification_targets[0].positive/negative thresholds, event timeouts, squelch, frame step) that ASI overrides from its NowPlaying__music_model_* flags

provenance.source: TheMuppets/proprietary_vendor_google_barbet (LineageOS vendor blobs extracted from the Google Pixel 5a factory image)
provenance.note: One shared model across three Snapdragon Pixel generations; git blob hashes recomputed locally and matched. The blob is Google-proprietary Pixel firmware borrowed with the user's explicit approval; it stays in the ignored bundle and appears in Git only as these hashes.

gate_analysis.switch_condition: AmbientMusicSettings fragment enables the main switch only when AmbientMusicServiceManager.l() && r()
gate_analysis.l: allowed-for-user; measured true (the setup wizard's Turn-on button, gated by exactly l(), renders enabled)
gate_analysis.r: requires music_detector.sound_model and music_detector.descriptor under /product/etc/firmware (else /vendor, else /system); the Tensor tflite variant is chosen only when music_detector.sound_model_tflite exists, which it does not here, so the classic Qualcomm-DSP pair is what this device loads
already_present: CAPTURE_AUDIO_HOTWORD, MANAGE_SOUND_TRIGGER, CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT, RECORD_AUDIO granted to ASI (uid 10299, in the audio-policy hotword list)
30 live NowPlaying flags incl. enable_now_playing_for_main_user; the 79 undelivered ones fall back to compiled defaults (now_playing_allowed default true)
Settings injection via IA_SETTINGS + MUSIC_RECOGNITION category
gate_analysis.soundtrigger_module_0: QUALCOMM Technologies, Inc; description Sound Trigger HAL; version 259; uuid 68ab2d40-e860-11e3-95ef-0002a5d5c51b; recognitionModes 9 (VOICE_TRIGGER|GENERIC_TRIGGER); maxSoundModels 8; captureTransition true; concurrentCapture true; supportedModelArch unrestricted
gate_analysis.engine: DSP-only via SoundTriggerManagerCompat: reads the sound model bytes, loads a GenericSoundModel, starts intent-based recognition; the on-AP libsense_nnfp_v3 fingerprinter matches DSP-triggered audio against the downloaded music database

deviations_and_risks: Proprietary Google Pixel blob installed on a Xiaomi unit; approved by the user for this purpose, kept out of Git.

SVA compatibility unverified: the model was built for the Snapdragon 765G-era Sound Trigger firmware; this SoC runs SVA 7.0. QTI generic models are usually forward-compatible but the loadSoundModel result on device is the verdict.
Copies two files into /product only; no HAL, SELinux, vendor or identity change.
